Class MicronautRunnerPlugin

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.gradle.MicronautRunnerPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.gradle.api.Plugin<org.gradle.api.Project>
public class MicronautRunnerPlugin extends Object implements org.gradle.api.Plugin<org.gradle.api.Project>
Packages a Micronaut application as a runner jar: one executable archive in which every dependency remains an intact nested jar.

This is the interim plugin, io.micronaut.runner.standalone. The Micronaut Gradle plugin's io.micronaut.runner replaces it, with the same task names and the same micronaut { runner {} } block, and the two refuse to run in one build.

The plugin creates the "micronautRunner" extension, a MicronautRunnerExtension, which is also micronaut.runner in a build that applies a Micronaut plugin. It registers the "micronautRunnerJar" task, wires it into assemble and exposes its archive as the "micronautRunnerElements" configuration. It needs no configuration in a project that already applies the application plugin: the main class comes from the application block, the application classes and resources from the main source set's output, and the dependencies from the runtime classpath in resolution order. Only a project that applies a Shadow plugin also gets "validateMicronautRunnerShadowOutputs", which both archive tasks depend on.

Since:
1.0
